sights.address: Harambe Station, Africa, Disney's Animal Kingdom, Bay Lake, FL
sights.w: 1.2-mile, ~7-minute narrow-gauge steam-style train from Harambe past the backstage animal-care buildings; reopened 26 May 2026 with new narration by Robert Irwin, now running to Bluey's Wild World at Conservation Station (Rafiki's Planet Watch closed 23 Feb 2026).

sights.address: Black Spire Outpost, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, Disney's Hollywood Studios, Lake Buena Vista, FL
sights.w: Interactive simulator inside a full-size Millennium Falcon: six riders crew the cockpit as pilots, gunners and engineers, so the flight changes with how well you fly; WDWMagic and WDWInfo call it a Galaxy's Edge must-do.
sights.k: simulator star wars interactive galaxy's edge ride

sights.address: 101 S Boyd St, Winter Garden, FL
sights.w: Free museum in the 1913 Tavares & Gulf depot (opened 1983) run by the Winter Garden Heritage Foundation — Central Florida railroading history and one of the country's largest collections of dining-car china and silver.

sights.address: 1000 Holt Ave, Rollins College, Winter Park, FL
sights.w: Free teaching museum on the Rollins College lakefront (the Cornell Fine Arts Museum until 2021) — Old Masters to contemporary; its Alfond Collection of contemporary art hangs across the street in The Alfond Inn (monthly art tours).
sights.k: art museum free rollins college contemporary
